According to TipRanks, Moeller has an average return of 10.5% and a 43.62% success rate on recommended stocks.In addition to Canaccord Genuity, AeroVironment also received a Buy from Goldman Sachs’s Noah Poponak in a report issued on March 15. However, on March 17, TipRanks – OpenAI reiterated a Hold rating on AeroVironment (NASDAQ: AVAV).Based on AeroVironment’s latest earnings release for the quarter ending January 31, the company reported a quarterly revenue of $408.05 million and a GAAP net loss of $156.55 million. Prime Minister Carney announces Canada has achieved the NATO 2% defence spending target HALIFAX, NS, March 26, 2026 /CNW/ - In an increasingly dangerous and divided world, Canada must be prepared – to defend ourselves and our values, to secure our sovereignty, and to stand with our Allies. For too long, Canada did not sufficiently build that strength. By 2014, Canada's defence spending had fallen to just 1% of our GDP, half of our obligations as a NATO member.
